column3: Signature contract: ImportApi.importDump declares signal: AbortSignal and Promise<void>, but the only wired caller (import.tsx) and the machine pass/expect different shapes across the stack; bcca842 must retcon the parameter to a full AbortController and the result to Promise<{completed}> to make caller and callee agree (fixed by bcca842; bot comment "importDump signature changed but callers not updated")

Abort race (stopped-flag): the import actor's teardown aborts the controller but the in-flight importDump promise keeps running; its settled handlers check controller.signal.aborted and can fire PROGRESS/IMPORTED/FAIL into a torn-down actor, and cleanup() can delete temp files while a chunk write is still in flight (fixed by 95e011a's stopped flag; bot comment at 11be74c :145 "cleanup() deletes temp files that are still being read/written")
